name: brianjordans-console
description: Management console for brianjordans.com: React SPA served by a Fastify server behind Google SSO

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix infra install
scripts.build: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.deploy:foundation: cd infra && npx cdk deploy BrianJordansConsoleFoundation
scripts.deploy:infra: cd infra && npx cdk deploy BrianJordansConsole
